notes.title: 📢 NOX AETERNA - Veil of Darkness - now available for free!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I'm happy to announce that NOX AETERNA, my first published visual novel, is now free to play. 🎉

As a solo developer, this project has been an important experience and a passion project for me. I originally released it as a commercial game, but I realized it could reach more players if it was freely available.

The game uses AI-generated illustrations. I realize the subject matter may be controversial. 

But I hope you see the game for what it is: a humorous yet profound adventure about friendship, a little but ancient vampire girl, and the machinations of an immortal parallel society.

Thank you to everyone who has supported the game so far. I appreciate any feedback and reviews. They help me greatly for possible future projects. 💙

Enjoy playing!

notes.title: NOX AETERNA - Major update
notes.content:
I have updated the game to now use the Godot engine.
This allowed me to finally to fix the screen flickering issue with the steam overlay.
Additionally, I have made a complete overhaul of the main menu and added fog effects.

notes.title: NOX AETERNA - Veil of Darkness - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Welcome to the world of gloom

It's finally here, NOX AETERNA is released!

What else is new? 
In addition to a few small corrections, there are now also achievements so that you can be sure not to miss any of the subplots and Easter eggs in the game!
